title: The Five Elders Strike
next_chapter_hook: Just as the conspiracy of the Five Elders' remnants completely fell apart, a pair of deep eyes in the depths of the Elder's Hall were注视着着 the Council Hall—those were Ling Yuan's arrangements, and the Sect Competition would become the stage for his正式 confrontation with Chen Ji.

text.content: Dawn broke, and disciples gathered outside the Tianqing Sect Council Hall. Today was the day the Five Elders' remnants would formally strike, the atmosphere oppressively suffocating. Inside the Council Hall, five gloomy faces stood in a row, led by the Fifth Elder—that ancient who had been humiliated by Chen Ji before the entire Sect Competition.

Chen Ji stood below the hall, his expressioncalm如常. His gaze swept over the Five Elders' faces restraining triumph, andsneered in his heart—these跳梁小丑 truly thought a few forged secret letters could bring him down? Mr. Mo's warning from yesterday still echoed in his ears: "The small fish cannot make waves, but the hands behind them are the true threat."

dialogue.content: The Fifth Elder struck first, his voice like thunder: "Chen Ji! You are merely an Outer Disciple/Servant—what right do you have to monopolize the secret realm spot? Today I shall seek justice in the name of sect righteousness!" His voice echoed within the Council Hall, every word carrying三分 official authority and七分 killing intent.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, his gaze如古井无波. He didn't立刻反驳, but静静地看着 Fifth Elder's performance, his lips even revealing a faint hint of a smile. This composure made the Fifth Elder increasingly furious, yet also sparked hidden unease in his heart—why was this boy so calm?

dialogue.content: At this moment, a sturdy figure strode into the Council Hall. Han Liesneered着走来, his gaze来回扫视 between Chen Ji and the Fifth Elder. "Fifth Elder, Chen Ji is indeed suspicious. Not only did he obtain逆天机缘 in the secret realm, but he also has connections with the demonic path woman—I witnessed this myself!"

text.content: The Council Hall erupted in uproar. Han Lie's words were like a heavy bomb, stirring waves among the crowd. The Fifth Elder stroked his beard with a smile, his eyes full of certainty: "Chen Ji, what else do you have to say? The number one genius of Xuanwu Sect testified personally—you are guilty of associating with the demonic path and betraying the sect, the evidence is conclusive!"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji let out a light laugh, that laughter exceptionally clear in the silent Council Hall. "Senior Brother Han, are you certain you wish to testify here?" His tone was轻描淡写, yet Han Lie felt莫名寒意. "Do you know that the crime of false testimony is heavier than associating with the demonic path?"

text.content: The Fifth Elderscoffed coldly一声: "Chen Ji, stop trying to change the subject! Someone—" Before he finished speaking, Chen Ji had already taken out a Jade Slip from his sleeve. "Why the rush, Fifth Elder? Why not first take a look at this." The Jade Slip glowed faintly in the air, while Chen Ji's gaze had already turned toward the depths of the Elder's Hall. "Mr. Mo, it's your turn to appear."

Sudden gusts of阴风 swept through the Council Hall, as a illusory figure slowly emerged from the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's sleeve. Mr. Mo's残魂凝聚, white-haired and white-bearded, his gaze深邃如渊. His appearance made everyone present gasp—could this be the legendary Tianji Record Guardian?

dialogue.content: Mr. Mo surveyed his surroundings, his voice清冷如寒冰: "I am the old friend of Chen Xuan and guardian of the Tianji Record. Fifth Elder, you claim Chen Ji associates with the demonic path—then tell me, was this secret letter written personally by you, or did you order someone to forge it?" His gaze如刀, piercing directly into the Fifth Elder's heart.

text.content: The Fifth Elder's expression大变, pointing at Mr. Mo厉声道: "Ridiculous! This old thing is merely a残魂邪祟—Chen Ji associating with evil objects makes the crime even worse!" Yet his voice had already lost its刚才的笃定, a flash of panic flickering in his eyes. Chen Ji watched his色厉内荏 appearance,sneered in his heart—so little composure, yet daring to frame him?

dialogue.content: "Fifth Elder, this letter claims my father Chen Xuan colluded with the demonic path to destroy Tianqing Sect." Chen Ji's voicecalm如水, yet each word was诛心, "But why my father died that year, Fifth Elder, you know better than anyone—he died under the secret plot of the Five Elders and Xuanwu Sect!"

text.content: The moment these words landed, the Council Hall exploded. The Fifth Elder's face turned铁青, his lips trembling as he couldn't utter a word. Chen Ji pressed his advantage, the Jade Slip in his hand blazing with light, projecting a yellowed Letter before everyone's eyes. "This is my father Chen Xuan's Testament Letter, recording how the Five Elders colluded with external enemies and framed loyal men!"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's voice echoed within the Council Hall, each word如惊雷炸响: "Fifth Elder, you claim you act for the sect's righteousness—then I ask you, thirty years ago, who leaked my father's whereabouts to Xuanwu Sect? And who, in the sect's moment of crisis, secretly made deals with the demonic path?"

text.content: The Fifth Elder如遭雷击, retreating several steps. He never imagined Chen Ji possessed such damaging evidence! The elders in the Council Hall had varied expressions—some shocked, some深恩, otherssecretly庆幸 they hadn't rushed to take sides. Mr. Mo's voice rang out again: "Chen Xuan discovered the secret agreement between the Five Elders and Xuanwu Sect, which is why he was murdered."

Han Lie's expression became extremely ugly. He originally came to give false testimony to bring down Chen Ji, but now had been counterattacked. He狠狠瞪了 Fifth Elder, whispering: "Fifth Elder, what is going on here?" The Fifth Elder's face如死灰, his lips trembling, unable to utter a single word.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stepped forward slowly, his gaze如剑: "Senior Brother Han, you just claimed you witnessed me associating with the demonic path woman—then I ask, which day, which hour, which location?" His voice wasn't loud, yet Han Lie felt如坠冰窟. "I remember that day, I was at the Inner Sect Martial Arena discussing the Dao with Senior Sister Su—I never left for half an hour."

text.content: The Council Hall erupted in uproar. Chen Ji took out a recording Jade Slip,注入神识, and the images from that day at the Inner Sect Martial Arena appeared clearly. "Everyone please observe, the images carry timestamps. That day, from Chen Hour to Wu Hour, Senior Sister Su and I were at the Martial Arena—so I ask Senior Brother Han, when and where did you see me?"

dialogue.content: Han Lie's forehead冷汗涔涔, his gaze躲闪. "This... this must be coincidence..." His voice grew quieter and quieter, finally completely哑火. Seeing the tide turning, the Fifth Elder厉声道: "Han Lie! How dare you use false testimony to frame your fellow disciple—what is your crime!"—apparently willing to sacrifice the piece to protect himself, shifting all blame onto Han Lie.

text.content: Han Lie怒吼: "Fifth Elder! You told me to come testify! You said as long as we brought down Chen Ji, you would let me enter the secret realm—" Before he finished, the Fifth Elder暴喝一声 to interrupt. The dog-eat-dog spectacle between the two revealed the本质 of this frame-up to everyone. Waves ofscoffed echoed through the crowd.

Just then, a sudden commotion came from outside the Council Hall. Outer Disciples spontaneously gathered, the one at the front shouting loudly: "Brother Chen! The Outer Disciples jointly petition, requesting the Sect Master severely punish those who frame fellow disciples!" Waves of voices rose one after another,群情激奋. The support of the Outer Disciples propelled Chen Ji's momentum to its peak.

The Fifth Elder's face如土色,浑身颤抖. He never expected that a disciple he deemedtrash would possess such deep scheming mind and such broad mass foundation. He looked toward the depths of the Elder's Hall, where a pair of深邃 eyes watched everything—a flash of Ling Yuan's figure. The Fifth Elder's heart一寒, knowing he had been abandoned.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly turned, facing the Fifth Elder, his tonecalm yet带着不容置疑的dignified: "Fifth Elder, according to sect rules, what is the punishment for framing fellow disciples?" His gaze swept over everyone present. "Today, I could have pursued this matter to the end—but considering your advanced age, I will give you one dignified choice."

choice.prompt: The Five Elders' strike has reached a dead end, Chen Ji controls the overall situation. Facing these跳梁小丑, how will he handle this闹剧?

choices.description: Showing mercy to the Five Elders, displaying the protagonist's political sophistication and vision, also leaving foreshadowing for the future.
choices.visible_reward: Gain a reputation for magnanimity, winning the favor of more neutral parties.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji淡淡一笑: "Fifth Elder, as long as you publicly admit your mistake before the Sect Competition and resign from your elder position, I will not pursue today's matter." His voicecalm如水, yet left the Fifth Elder无颜面对江东父老.

text.content: The Fifth Elder's face如死灰, yet had to accept this condition. Applause erupted in the Council Hall, Outer Disciples cheered Chen Ji's name. At this moment, everyone saw clearly—this formertrash servant was the one who truly laughed last.

choices.description: Pursue relentlessly, uproot the Five Elders' faction completely, eliminate all hidden dangers, displaying the protagonist's iron-handed methods.
choices.visible_reward: Completely Dismantle the Five Elders' Power, Monopolize the Secret Realm Spot

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's gaze一冷: "Fifth Elder, you framed fellow disciples, colluded with external enemies, forged testament letters—three crimes combined, today I will ask the Sect Master to abolish your cultivation and expel you from the sect!" His voice如寒冰. "And you four elders—none of you will escape!"

text.content: The Five Elders collapsed to the ground, faces如死灰. The other four elders scrambled to clear their names, the Council Hall in chaos. Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, like an immovable mountain. Outer Disciples cheered joyfully—at this moment, Chen Ji's reputation in Tianqing Sect reached its peak.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji拱手 toward the Sect Master's direction: "Sect Master, this matter involves deep implications, not only concerning the Five Elders' remnants, but possibly the lurking forces within the sect. This disciple ventures to suggest: hand the Five Elders over to the Sect Master for handling, while thoroughly investigating their associates to eradicate future troubles."

text.content: The Sect Masterslightly点头, appreciation flickering in his gaze. This move by Chen Ji showed respect for the Sect Master while handing over the handling power, leaving himself greater operational space. Mr. Mo nodded slightly beside him—this boy is increasingly like his father.

Mr. Mo's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a hint ofgratified: "Well done, but do you know the Five Elders are merely chess pieces?" His tonemeaningful. "The true chess player is currently watching you from the depths of the Elder's Hall. Chen Ji, the Sect Competition will be your first direct confrontation with Ling Yuan—you need more trump cards."

Outside the Council Hall, the sunlight was perfect. Outer Disciples swarmed around Chen Ji cheering, yet Chen Ji's gaze had already越过 the crowd, looking toward the vaguely可见 figure in the depths of the Elder's Hall. Ling Yuan—that inheritance candidate skipped by the Tianji Record, that old enemy who harbors resentment toward his father Chen Xuan—finally about to surface?

A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips. Ling Yuan had been arranging for years, using the Five Elders as discarded pieces, merely to probe his depth. Unfortunately, Ling Yuan would never understand—he Chen Ji has never fought alone. From Mr. Mo to Su Qingyao, from Outer Disciples to the hearts of all Tianqing Sect disciples, he had long woven an invisible net.

"Next chapter: the Sect Competition." Chen Ji silently念道 in his heart. "Ling Yuan, the Five Elders' remnants, and that Eye of Heavenly Dao always hiding behind the scenes—since you want to play, I will accompany you to play properly." In the depths of his eyes, the Tianji Record's runesslightly闪烁, foreshadowing the approaching storm...
